visualEvidence.observation: S22 portrait pixels show Nika pointing toward the courtyard canopy, Matteo listening and Giulia working with the plan in the Villa Serena sea-facing courtyard; no forbidden ceremony or extra cast is visible.
Reference pixels establish Nika's short dark bob, light complexion and practical off-white work layer.
Reference pixels establish Matteo's dark wavy hair, beard and restrained summer-work continuity.
Reference pixels establish Giulia as an older competent worker with grey hair, sage-grey shirt and utility apron.
Accepted contact-sheet pixels establish the grounded semi-real Mediterranean visual language and warm daylight baseline.

decision: S22 and S23 are READY_FOR_GENERATION; S22 portrait is a usable canon anchor. Final art acceptance is not performed.

findings.observation: Preserve Giulia's agency and the concrete plan-to-canopy action; avoid Matteo-dominant hierarchy.
Make the two working plans visibly distinct and make the canopy read as rain protection, not a generic sunshade.
Keep the lower dialogue-safe area quiet; the portrait's lower props require runtime verification.
Keep Giulia's tablet handoff and cleared passage legible without a romantic couple pose or ceremony styling.

coverageLimitations: This is the pre-generation analysis phase; S22/S23 landscape and S23 portrait pixels are not available and no final acceptance is claimed.
